description: Canonical manifest of the ESPHome external components vendored in components/ (SENSE360-CANONICALISATION-001 PR 08). Every directory under components/ must have a row here and every row must have a directory; tests/test_external_components.py enforces both directions plus the rules block. Provenance records what the tree and its recorded comments prove - nothing here is hardware, bench or compliance evidence.

rules.never_fork_upstream_for_product_behaviou: Sense360 product behaviour lives in the sense360 component's shared engines and the PR 09..12 domain components, never in a forked copy of an upstream sensor driver. Raw sensor communication uses built-in ESPHome drivers wherever one exists; a vendored driver directory is permitted only with a provenance row here and a named disposition_owner.
rules.foundation_declares_no_hardware_io: The sense360 component is logic-and-schema only: no I2C/UART/SPI device driver code, no entities, no pins, no buses, no platforms. Enforced by tests/test_external_components.py.
rules.delivery_path_is_components_only: The former include/sense360/ delivery-only component (REMOTE-PACKAGE-HEADER-RESOLUTION-001) was replaced by components/sense360/ in PR 08 and must not return.
rules.delivery_axis: delivery: 'base' means the component is declared by packages/base/external_components.yaml AND by the CI override heredocs (setup-esphome-build action, manual-firmware-artifacts.yml) - the two lists are pinned equal to the base set by tests/test_external_components.py. delivery: 'inline-board' means a board package declares its own git-source external_components block (today: sfa40 and mics_stm8 in packages/boards/s360-210-airiq.yaml, kept git-sourced for remote consumers); such a component must NOT also enter the base lists, or the same component would resolve from two sources.
rules.radar_drivers_are_built_in: The LD2412 / LD2450 / LD24xx drivers come from built-in ESPHome (>= the requirements-dev.txt pin, which ships all three) since SENSE360-CANONICALISATION-001 PR 10 retired the vendored copies under the no-fork rule. Re-vendoring an upstream driver requires a new manifest row with provenance and a named disposition owner.

sense360.provenance: Introduced by SENSE360-CANONICALISATION-001 PR 08; subsumes the include/sense360/ delivery hack. Ships the canonical header-only logic engines exercised by tests/unit/ and the identity schema foundation.

mics_stm8.provenance: MiCS-4514 gas sensor read through the on-board STM8 bridge (S360-210 AirIQ). No built-in ESPHome driver exists for this bridge path.

sfa40.provenance: Sensirion SFA40 HCHO module driver. The SFA40 fitment question stays owner-reserved (OD-SOT-008) and is not resolved by this manifest.
sfa40.disposition_owner: SENSE360-CANONICALISATION-001 PR-11 (Migrate AirIQ and VentIQ); OD-SOT-008 stays open

sense360_roomiq.provenance: Introduced by SENSE360-CANONICALISATION-001 PR 09 (docs/architecture/sense360-roomiq-component-plan.md). Glue over the canonical RoomIQ engine singleton in components/sense360/ - input feeding, configuration, the single-owner publish-on-change switchboard. No model logic, no raw hardware I/O (sources are ordinary ESPHome sensors composed by the board package).

sense360_presence.provenance: Introduced by SENSE360-CANONICALISATION-001 PR 10 (docs/architecture/sense360-presence-component-plan.md). Glue over the canonical presence fusion singleton in components/sense360/ - input feeding, runtime mode/clear-delay control interplay, the publish switchboard. No model logic, no raw hardware I/O; the OD-SOT-004 PIR-vs-radar evidence distinction is unchanged.

sense360_airiq.provenance: Introduced by SENSE360-CANONICALISATION-001 PR 11 (docs/architecture/sense360-airiq-ventiq-component-plan.md). Glue over the canonical AirIQ engine singleton in components/sense360/ - the same instance the blower framework reads for ventilation demand and the VentIQ engine embeds for pollutant truth. No model logic, no raw hardware I/O.
